title: The First Image and the Two Mysteries of Sun and Moon
description: T66 expounds the seven goods divine truth works in the soul when it shines, against the seven evils of the night: light to the understanding, rest and peace, wakefulness, nourishment to perception's growths, gathering of beasts back to lairs, dissolving of evil enchantments, manifesting in the natural the sign of the Radiance from above. The fashioning of Adam to bear the divine likeness is by this very illumining, which is itself the gate of life and stronghold of peace. T67 names the two mysteries shown daily in sun and moon: when the soul is unillumined, the proprium fills its inner life with blindness and fear; when divine truth rises in the rational and shines, five gifts come (light, beauty, peace, life loosed, power and fragrance), each exceeding every other good of its kind. Three further likenesses are revealed in the same shining, each carrying the mystery of the Lord in his inmost.
